en: Sepia-toned street scene showing an early 20th‑century European city. Cobblestone streets with several sets of tram tracks curve past rows of gabled townhouses. Two trams are visible on the right, with overhead wires crossing the sky. On the left is a small square bordered by low buildings with tiled roofs; one house has arched windows on the ground floor and a sign on the façade. Tall, slender poles and old-fashioned street lamps stand on the square, and a few pedestrians are scattered along the street.
